# football-tv.today

> Which UK TV channel or stream shows each football match: Premier League, EFL, FA Cup, WSL, SPFL and England. One page per match, checked against the broadcasters' and leagues' own listings once a day.

Kick-off times are UK time. A match with no confirmed broadcaster says so; nothing is guessed. A match that moves keeps its old address, which redirects to the new date.

## Pages
- [Football on TV today](https://football-tv.today/): every televised match today, with channels
- [Tomorrow](https://football-tv.today/tomorrow/): tomorrow's televised matches
- [Teams](https://football-tv.today/teams/): each team's next televised match
- [Competitions](https://football-tv.today/competitions/)
- Match pages: https://football-tv.today/match/<date>-<home>-v-<away>/ (all listed in the sitemap)

## Data
- [matches.json](https://football-tv.today/data/matches.json): every upcoming match: competition, teams, kick-off (ISO 8601), channels, url, last update
- [sitemap.xml](https://football-tv.today/sitemap.xml): every page, with the date its content last changed
